commands.command:
mkdir release-artifact release-artifact/release
aws s3 cp "s3://${AWS_RELEASES_BUCKET}/releases/${RELEASE_SHA}/site.tar.gz" release-artifact/site.tar.gz --only-show-errors
aws s3 cp "s3://${AWS_RELEASES_BUCKET}/releases/${RELEASE_SHA}/site.tar.gz.sha256" release-artifact/site.tar.gz.sha256 --only-show-errors
(cd release-artifact && shasum -a 256 -c site.tar.gz.sha256 && tar -xzf site.tar.gz -C release)
commands.stderr:
shasum: /tmp/<site-project>-site-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567.tar.gz: No such file or directory
shasum: WARNING: 1 listed file could not be read
